Titel: Freelance Privacy & AI Governance Consultant (GDPR / EU AI Act)
Unternehmen: Lumacore Software AG
Ort: Berlin, Berlin, Germany (Remote)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4188102377/
Abgerufen am: 24.09.2026 07:32

About the job
Lumacore builds document automation software for insurers and public administrations. More and more of our features rely on large language models, some hosted by third-party providers in the US. We need an experienced privacy professional to set up our AI governance before the high-risk obligations of the EU AI Act apply.

What you will do
Set up an AI governance framework and an inventory of all AI systems and models in use
Classify our products and internal tools under the risk categories of the EU AI Act
Run data protection impact assessments and, where required, fundamental rights impact assessments
Perform vendor due diligence for LLM providers, including transfer impact assessments and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework
Update the records of processing, data processing agreements and privacy notices
Advise product managers and engineers in sprint reviews
Train the teams on privacy by design and responsible AI

What you bring
5+ years in data protection, in-house or at a law firm or consultancy
CIPP/E or CIPM certification
Practical experience with AI Act readiness projects
A solid understanding of how machine learning systems are built and operated
ISO/IEC 42001 knowledge is a plus
Fluent English; German is nice to have

Engagement
Contract for 6 months, 3 to 4 days per week
Day rate: 900 to 1,050 EUR
Start: 01.11.2026
Fully remote within the EU, occasional workshops in Berlin

Employment type: Contract
